selection.rule: All three seeds and both validation starts must pass; no best-seed selection. Pilot seed 20261012 is excluded.

validation.status: predeclared before formal confirmation; finite power iterations are estimates, not certified norm bounds

acceptance.reason: Engineering targets declared before confirmation: 1e-5 global/input allows roughly 100x margin over pilot one-vector errors near 9.3e-8, without interpreting those as norm bounds. Component 1e-4 accommodates the pilot weakest output near 2.5e-6 but still demands 0.01% relative accuracy. Selected-block 1e-3 is a response-relative, nonzero-block check consistent with bounded spectra around 1e-5 at rank 47, not a guarantee of full-block error. Every random/localized/smooth response in both directions must improve on leaves-only by at least 100x. Failures require a separately versioned exploratory revision and fresh confirmation; never relax this record after observing formal seeds.

calibration.status: completed feasibility pilot, not C.11 acceptance

contract.bp7: retained negative evidence; not a mandatory success gate
contract.authority: PI decision: larger Frontera 3D fault replaces BP7 as required successful dataset; small-fault BP7 has insufficient meaningful far field
contract.read_budget_change: The old bounded-preflight 1 TB ceiling is superseded only for this reviewed formal protocol: at most 300 streamed passes / 6 TB per seed including validation and timing, plus one bounded-memory matrix-hash scan per invocation.
